docstring:
Extract host and port from a netloc or 'host:port' string.

Strips userinfo if present (user:pass@host:port).
Handles IPv6 addresses with or without square brackets.
Returns (host, port_or_empty).

Args:
    raw_hostport: Raw netloc or host:port string.

Returns:
    Tuple of (host, port_string_or_empty).
ref_test:
def test_split_host_port():
    assert split_host_port('localhost:8080') == ('localhost', '8080')
    assert split_host_port('example.com') == ('example.com', '')
    assert split_host_port('user:pass@192.168.1.1:443') == ('192.168.1.1', '443')
    assert split_host_port('[2001:db8::1]:8443') == ('2001:db8::1', '8443')
    assert split_host_port('[2001:db8::1]') == ('2001:db8::1', '')
    assert split_host_port('2001:db8::1') == ('2001:db8::1', '')
    assert split_host_port('') == ('', '')

test_split_host_port()
